name: @utdk/figma
description:
Generated UTDK provider client for Figma API. This is the OpenAPI specification for the [Figma REST API](https://www.figma.com/developers/api).

Note: we are releasing the OpenAPI specification as a beta given the large surface area and complexity of the REST API. If you notice any inaccuracies with the specification, please [file an issue](https://github.com/figma/rest-api-spec/issues).

scopes.current_user:read: Read your name, email, and profile image.
scopes.file_comments:write: Post and delete comments and comment reactions in files.
scopes.file_content:read: Read the contents of files, such as nodes and the editor type.
scopes.file_dev_resources:write: Write to dev resources in files.
scopes.file_variables:read: Read variables in Figma file. Note: this is only available to members in Enterprise organizations.
scopes.file_variables:write: Write to variables in Figma file. Note: this is only available to members in Enterprise organizations.
scopes.file_versions:read: Read the version history for files you can access.
scopes.files:read: Deprecated. Read files, projects, users, versions, comments, components & styles, and webhooks.
scopes.library_assets:read: Read data of individual published components and styles.
scopes.library_content:read: Read published components and styles of files.
scopes.projects:read: List projects and files in projects.
scopes.team_library_content:read: Read published components and styles of teams.

scopes.org:activity_log_read: Read activity logs in the organization.
